County overview, first paragraph: administrative coverage and population
records.verbatim_quote: 全县划为15个区（镇），124个公社，570个大队，4145个自然村；（海子街区有7个公社未设大队仅222个生产队），56条街巷。居住着汉、彝、苗、京、满、蒙、回、藏、壮、布依、侗、瑶、白、水、土、仡佬、羌、景颇、泰、黎及其他等二十多种民族；总人口：181200户，916214人，其中汉族占人口总数的90.66%，少数民族占9.34%。

observation.name: 毕节县
observation.note: The overview counts 15 districts and towns, 124 communes, 570 brigades, 4,145 natural villages, and 56 streets. Seven Haizijie communes have 222 production teams without a brigade tier. Additional ethnic groups are mentioned collectively.
